## Review
- [ ] Only intended files; no credentials, runtime data or personal pass data
- [ ] Existing workflow, isolation and approval guards preserved
- [ ] Failure/loading/empty states and unknown usage remain honest
- [ ] Commit subjects and PR title follow CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] One teammate reviewed; integrator owns merge and final demo checks
